manifest.name: Neuro
manifest.author: Echo Opera
manifest.description: Neuroscience and cell biology as living light: dendrites, spikes, synapses, tractography, morphogens and microscopy.

styles.name: Neural Arbor
styles.blurb: Dendritic trees grow from their somata while action potentials race out along every branch.

styles.name: Action Potential
styles.blurb: Myelinated axons fire: the spike leaps node to node as ions flood each node of Ranvier.

styles.name: Synaptic Cleft
styles.blurb: Vesicles dock and fuse, neurotransmitter diffuses across the cleft and switches the receptors on.

styles.name: Connectome
styles.blurb: Tractography bundles arc through a turning brain volume while signal pulses stream along every fibre.

styles.name: Cortical Fold
styles.blurb: Gyri and sulci wrap a turning hemisphere while waves of activity sweep across the cortex.

styles.name: Mitosis
styles.blurb: Chromosomes condense, align on the spindle and split; the camera follows a daughter until it becomes the parent again.

styles.name: Physarum
styles.blurb: A slime-mould transport network: veins pulse with shuttle streaming as the organism forages between food.

styles.name: Morphogen
styles.blurb: Turing patterns bloom and morph: spots, stripes and labyrinths from one band-limited wave field.

styles.name: Epithelium
styles.blurb: Living tissue: domed cells jostle and breathe, nuclei turn, and a calcium wave rolls through.

styles.name: Calcium Wave
styles.blurb: Two-photon view of a neural field: GCaMP cells flash and spreading waves ripple through the network.

styles.name: Microtubule Transit
styles.blurb: Kinesin motors step cargo along the cytoskeletal highway while dynein hauls it back.

styles.name: Protein Fold
styles.blurb: A random coil collapses into helices and sheets, holds its fold, then melts back into chaos.

styles.name: Organoid
styles.blurb: A raymarched cell cluster blooms and buds, its nuclei glowing through translucent membranes.

styles.name: EEG Cascade
styles.blurb: Multichannel EEG scrolls over a live spectrogram; spikes and alpha spindles ripple across channels.

styles.name: Grid Cells
styles.blurb: An explorer roams its arena; grid cells fire on a hexagonal lattice and spikes pile up where fields are crossed.

styles.name: Neural Lace
styles.blurb: A holographic brain turns inside a glowing filament mesh while data pulses race across the lace.

styles.name: Chromatin
styles.blurb: The double helix turns, unzips at a replication fork and zips back while nucleosome beads drift behind.

styles.name: Confocal
styles.blurb: A z-stack sweeps through cultured neurons: three fluorescence channels drift in and out of focus.
